objects.definition: enum class ByteOrder { Host, LittleEndian, BigEndian };
objects.description: Strongly-typed enumeration of byte orders used to parameterize conversions: host-native, little-endian, and big-endian.

functions.name: toEndianness
functions.signature:
template <ByteOrder Endianness, typename T>
inline T toEndianness(T value);
functions.description: Converts an integer value from host byte order to the specified endianness (Host, LittleEndian, or BigEndian) using the corresponding EndiannessConverter specialization. Use when serializing integers to a specific on-the-wire or storage byte order.
requirements: Template parameter T must have an EndiannessConverter specialization, i.e., sizeof(T) must be 1, 2, 4, or 8 bytes.
Endianness must be one of ByteOrder::Host, ByteOrder::LittleEndian, or ByteOrder::BigEndian.
T should be an integral type (signed or unsigned) whose size matches one of the provided specializations; otherwise this will fail to compile due to missing specialization or static_assert.

functions.name: fromEndianness
functions.signature:
template <ByteOrder Endianness, typename T>
inline T fromEndianness(T value);
functions.description: Converts an integer value from the specified endianness (Host, LittleEndian, or BigEndian) to host byte order using the corresponding EndiannessConverter specialization. Use when deserializing integers read from a specified-endian source.
requirements: Template parameter T must have an EndiannessConverter specialization, i.e., sizeof(T) must be 1, 2, 4, or 8 bytes.
Endianness must be one of ByteOrder::Host, ByteOrder::LittleEndian, or ByteOrder::BigEndian.
T should be an integral type (signed or unsigned) whose size matches one of the provided specializations; otherwise this will fail to compile due to missing specialization or static_assert.

functions.name: EndiannessConverter<ByteOrder::Host, T, sizeof(uint8_t)>::to
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
static T EndiannessConverter<ByteOrder::Host, T, sizeof(uint8_t)>::to(T value);
functions.description: Pass-through conversion for 8-bit values when converting from host to Host endianness. No byte swapping is performed.

static T EndiannessConverter<ByteOrder::LittleEndian, T, sizeof(uint16_t)>::to(T value);
functions.description: Converts 16-bit values from host byte order to little-endian using htole16, with casts to/from uint16_t.
